_extraction_flags.notes: Excellent Photonic W-band ISAC! FDM-based SCM (16-QAM) + LFM waveform at 96.5 GHz. 10km fiber + 1m wireless. Photonic heterodyning for mmW generation. True hybrid fiber-wireless O-ISAC.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig.1: Centralized fiber-to-BS architecture, FDM waveform (SCM+LFM). Fig.2: Experimental setup - ECL heterodyning, MZM modulation, 10km fiber, 100 GHz PD, horn antennas. Spectrum shows 2 GHz SCM + 9.6 GHz LFM + 400 MHz guard = 12 GHz total. Fig.3: BER vs ROP, Resolution vs ROP, PMNR curves. Fig.4: De-chirped echo spectra, <1 cm error after calibration.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: Photonic W-band (96.5 GHz) ISAC with fiber-wireless integration. Waveform: FDM of SCM (communication) + LFM (sensing). Photonic heterodyning (ECL1 @ 193.1 THz + ECL2 @ 193.1965 THz) generates W-band carrier. Sensing: Photonic de-chirping at BS, centralized processing.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: 48 Gbps (comm-only) or 8 Gbps (ISAC mode), 16-QAM, 2 GHz BW. Sensing: 2.75 cm resolution (9.6 GHz LFM BW), <1 cm distance error after calibration. 10 km fiber + 1 m wireless. PMNR >12 dB at ROP >-30 dBm. BER floor ~10^-4 at ROP >-5 dBm.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Contribution: Simple photonic W-band ISAC architecture with centralized processing, seamlessly integrated with fiber-distributed networks. Gap: Short wireless link (1m), single target sensing, no multi-user or MIMO demonstration.

bibliographic.title: W-band Photonic-based Integration of Sensing and Communication with Frequency-division Multiplexed Waveforms in Fiber-wireless Integrated Network
bibliographic.authors: Boyu Dong, Guoqiang Li, HaiPeng Wang, Junlian Jia, Jianyang Shi, Junwen Zhang, Nan Chi

application.scenario_description: 6G fiber-wireless integrated network with centralized processing. Smart city and V2X scenarios requiring simultaneous high-speed communication and high-resolution sensing.

key_contribution.key_contribution: Simple photonic W-band ISAC with FDM waveform (SCM+LFM) integrated into centralized fiber-distributed network architecture. Photonic heterodyning for mmW generation + photonic de-chirping for sensing backhaul.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Previous photonic ISAC systems were complex or lacked high-speed communication; this achieves both with simple architecture compatible with existing fiber networks.

identification.scenario_label: W-band Photonic ISAC with FDM Waveform

transmitter.notes: ECL-1 @ 193.1 THz (100 kHz linewidth), ECL-2 @ 193.1965 THz (96.5 GHz offset). Heterodyning generates W-band carrier. MZM-1 for ISAC signal modulation. AWG @ 60 GSa/s. Total BW 12 GHz: SCM (2 GHz) + Guard (400 MHz) + LFM (9.6 GHz).

receiver.notes: UE: Envelope detector for data recovery. Sensing: MZM-2 for photonic de-chirping → optical reference mixes with echo → de-chirped signal sent back to central office via fiber.

integration.notes: FDM: SCM (communication) and LFM (sensing) share 12 GHz bandwidth simultaneously. Common optical path, photonic heterodyning, centralized processing.

waveform.notes: FDM: 16-QAM SCM @ 2 GHz BW + LFM @ 9.6 GHz BW. T_LFM = 66.13 ns. 400 MHz guard band. Theoretical resolution δ_r = c/2B_r = 1.56 cm.

channel_fibre.notes: 10 km SMF for fiber-to-BS transmission. EDFA amplification.

channel_wireless.notes: 1 m wireless link at 96.5 GHz (W-band). Horn antennas for TX/RX. Corner reflector targets at 65-160 cm range.

comm_metrics.notes: ISAC mode: 8 Gbps (16-QAM, 2 GHz BW). Comm-only mode: 48 Gbps. BER floor ~10^-4 at ROP >-5 dBm. ISAC waveform has better BER than comm-only due to narrower SCM bandwidth.

sensing_metrics.notes: 2.75 cm resolution (9.6 GHz LFM BW). <1 cm distance error after external calibration (26 cm systematic bias corrected). PMNR >12 dB at ROP >-30 dBm.

tradeoff.notes: Fixed FDM allocation: 2 GHz comm + 9.6 GHz sensing. Comm-only mode (48 Gbps) vs ISAC mode (8 Gbps + 2.75 cm). Future work: flexible waveform for adaptive tradeoff.
